catalog_quirks.body: IteraCompute Free gives each account 30M tokens per calendar month (input + output, reasoning included) at 160,000 TPM with 128K total context and at most 8,192 output tokens, no card or recharge needed. The allowance resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st with no rollover and no paid overage: once spent, the API answers 429 until the reset. Free capacity is shared and may queue at peak (429 + Retry-After when full, 503 on infrastructure faults). Requests reserve their maximum tokens before settling, so a large max_tokens holds more of the allowance in flight. Thinking is on by default; send chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false for plain answers. Kimi K3 Free is not included: it needs a $10 recharge. https://iteracompute.com/free-tier-terms/
